attempt1: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: leaning shelter arch cradling one diagonal coral leaf opening
- silhouette: protective enclosing arch formed from one continuous ceramic shell, leaning subtly but resting on one stable continuous base
- crown: broad asymmetrical protective overhang framing the face
- opening: exactly one asymmetric diagonal leaf-shaped recessed opening, characteristic color inside
- pose: both rounded arms softly embracing the leaf opening
- expression: attentive
- exterior material: warm creamy ivory ceramic
- characteristic color: muted deep coral, precisely one hue family matching #B94F48
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- body height at least 2.4 times visible face height; elegant adult collectible proportion, never chibi
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening: the diagonal coral leaf opening; no other body openings except the seed mark
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, coral iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy, both visibly embracing the opening
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy

- one compact Palari seed mark on the lower body: EXACTLY SIX circular apertures arranged as a compact rectangle, FOUR visibly larger circles only at top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right, plus TWO visibly smaller circles stacked on the vertical centerline between those corner pairs; not six equal holes, not a grille
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.

Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, full figure visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height with generous clear space around overhang, arms, and continuous base.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details, random holes or more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances, generic mascot smiles, mouth, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes, upward-facing cavity, ring around the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks, extra characters, props, pedestal, cropped body, duplicated arms or eyes.
